source_note: Topic structure follows the OCR GCSE History (SHP) specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Both thematic options develop the skill of tracing change over a long period
Each option builds the same factors-of-change analysis across centuries
Public-health themes deepen when studied within the WWI period in depth
The depth study is examined alongside its linked historic environment site
The historic environment is a site study rooted in the chosen depth period
Site analysis applies the depth study's context to a physical place
Viking expansion provides the background to the Norman Conquest of England

Both examine empire, conquest and cultural encounter in depth
Modern political study links American change to twentieth-century dictatorship
